scope: Initial runtime/API migration comparison; no ReSTIR PT integration or B2 optimization

timing.selection: Last600 target-process/swapchain frames, drop final16; record unavailable FrameType field and require frame generation disabled in renderer config
timing.primary: GPUBusy process active-engine duration in ms; not exclusive DI/GI cost
timing.aggregation: Median of process-run medians, across-run bootstrap intervals; no frame pooling as independent trials
timing.resource_telemetry: nvidia-smi device-wide; background allocations remain included, not renderer-exclusive VRAM
timing.render_unfocused_guard: Keep original static-scene captureSequence active; first1200warmupframes finish before timed sample, sceneTime stays0 and noPNG is reached; ShouldRenderUnfocused remains true. Process termination is bounded.
timing.validation: Reject missing CSV, fewer than616 matchingPID rows, unexpectedPNG writes, multiple swapchains or parser failures.

quality.track: Captured tonemapped sRGB PNG; not linear HDR or paper-exact radiometric scores
quality.captures: Static captureSimple64frame warmup, separate from timed runs
quality.reference: B0 reference renderer2048spp; assess reference uncertainty separately
quality.repeat_control: Compare B0 repeat differences before attributing stochastic pixel differences to migration
quality.seed_limit: No verified CLI seed selector; repeated processes are not claimed independent Monte Carlo draws

exclusions: Early command-launch failures and child-debugger smoke are diagnostics only
Static-scene sequence pilot timed out because upstream sceneTime remains0; excluded from comparisons
Startup shader compilation, PNG readback/write, synthetic tool tests and paper tables are not benchmark samples
Unguarded wall-clock timing trials excluded because focus-dependent rendering caused missing frame data; retained under work/b1-first-runs as setup diagnostics.
promotion: Runtime build plus valid image/quality and timing checks; report inconclusive/mixed effects honestly, no assumed performance gain
